# BBYB.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp376.0 against Rp157.0 (expected total return 139.3%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- Credit cost is the stated first driver but runs 0.5% of loans in FY2026E rising only to 1.8% by FY2030E, while house comps model 3.2% (BBRI), 4.5% (ARTO) and 6.4% (BBHI) for comparable consumer/unsecured books and BBYB o
- The bear adds 60bp credit cost, 40bp NIM and 3pp growth and returns Rp232, 48% above the Rp157 price, so the claim that the stock is priced for a severe outcome is unsupported; the bear narrative itself says NPL gross pu
- Earnings momentum is negative and unmentioned: 9M2026 PAT Rp430.98bn is -7.1% yoy vs Rp464bn [S2][S11] and Q3-2026 alone is Rp136.1bn vs Rp187.9bn (-27.6% yoy); the report frames 9M2026 only as strengthening, and flat FY

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
